question: If the cost price of 70 articles is equal to the selling price of 40 articles, what will be the profit percentage?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

The cost price of 70 articles is equal to the selling price of 40 articles

**FORMULA USED:**

 profit%=(profit)/(costprice)times 100

**CALCULATIONS:**

The cost price of 70 articles is equal to the selling price of 40 articles

⇒ CP x 70= SP x 40

⇒ (CP)/(SP)=(4)/(7)

Let CP=Rs.4 and SP=Rs.7

⇒ Profit = SP - CP = 7 - 4 = Rs. 3

Profit Percentage is

⇒ Profit% =(profit)/(costprice)times 100=(3)/(4)times 100=3times 25=75

⇒ **T****he Profit percentage is 75%**
